name: test-strategy-plan
description: Produce a project test strategy + test plan. Strategy: testing objectives, quality goals, scope (in/out), test levels (unit / integration / contract / system / acceptance / exploratory), environments, entry/exit criteria per level, risk-based testing, tools, roles, governance. Plan: test schedules, resource allocation, test case prioritization, traceability matrix to requirements. Includes defect management process (classification, triage cadence, SLAs, root-cause categories). Hand-offs to automation / data / performance / security test skills. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
